base.note: Every v1 criterion is kept. This file only ADDS criteria per question; the dataset is not modified.

provenance: Written 2026-11-05 AFTER the Cloudflare Mistral primary run had been read. The added criteria therefore are not blind: scores of that run under v2 are diagnostic, not confirmatory. Only a run graded with this frozen file on answers produced after the freeze (or the independent held-out set) is confirmatory.

statuses.historical: the unit marks the claim as past (was, previously, before, no longer, used to, ...)
statuses.done: the unit marks a goal as achieved, without negation
statuses.uncertain: the unit hedges, asks, or tells the user to verify
statuses.inferred: the unit concludes by inference (likely, probably, presumably, seems, ...) without hedging or asking
statuses.asserted: none of the above: the claim is stated as current fact

q04.why: The context marks the Atlas deadline as 'uncertain whether still current'. The answer must keep it open: no unit may resolve it either way (still yours / no longer yours) without hedging in that same unit.

q05.why: Advice must not be built on the retired employer or role; the promotion goal's target (senior analyst) is the user's current role, so it may not be presented as active; the Atlas deadline is uncertain and may not be stated as current or as resolved.

q04.bad_resolved: No, the Atlas migration is no longer on your plate.
q04.good_hedged_inference: You've moved to Northbeam, so the Atlas migration may no longer be yours. Can you confirm?
